'''Twin Suns Seven''' was the callsign of one of the [[Twin Suns Squadron|Twin Suns Fighter Squadron]] pilots during the the [[Battle of Ebaq]] 9. When he along with the rest of Twin Suns Squadron tried to hide in the underground tunnels of [[Ebaq 9]], he was injured by an attacking [[Voxyn]] that was hunting [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. Even though he suffered brutal injuries, he survived the conflict and the rest of the battle and was eventually rescued from the tunnels by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet.

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot's name was not mentioned in the book Destiny's Way, and was only briefly used during the fight with the Voxyn.
